import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset Matrix

namespace UniformDeterminant

theorem replacement_weight_drop
    (a b c H p m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hp : H < p) (ha : p * m ≤ a) :
    (a - p * m) + H * (b + m + c) < a + H * (b + c) := by
  have hdrop : H * m < p * m := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hp hm
  omega

theorem determinant_row_factors
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (p : R) (k : Fin n → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i j, p ^ k i ∣ B i j) :
    p ^ (∑ i, k i) ∣ B.det := by
  classical
  choose C hC using h
  have hB : B = fun i j => p ^ k i * C i j := by
    funext i j
    exact hC i j
  refine ⟨Matrix.det C, ?_⟩
  rw [hB, Matrix.det_mul_row]
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]

theorem determinant_prefix_replacement
    {K : Type*} [CommRing K] {n : ℕ}
    (A B C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → C i j = 0)
    (hb : B = (1 + C) * A) :
    B.det = A.det := by
  have htri : (1 + C).BlockTriangular OrderDual.toDual := by
    intro i j hij
    have hij' : i < j := hij
    simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ne_of_lt hij', hc i j hij'.le]
  have hdiag : ∀ i, (1 + C) i i = 1 := by
    intro i
    simp [hc i i le_rfl]
  rw [hb, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular _ htri]
  simp [hdiag]

theorem integral_replacement_divisibility
    {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing K] {n : ℕ}
    (f : R →+* K) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
    (C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → C i j = 0)
    (hb : B.map f = (1 + C) * A.map f)
    (p : R) (k : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hentry : ∀ i j, p ^ k i ∣ B i j) :
    A.det = B.det ∧ p ^ (∑ i, k i) ∣ A.det := by
  have heq : A.det = B.det := by
    apply hf
    simpa only [RingHom.map_det] using
      (determinant_prefix_replacement (A.map f) (B.map f) C hc hb).symm
  exact ⟨heq, heq ▸ determinant_row_factors B p k hentry⟩

theorem frobenius_row_factor
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (x y z p : R) (r k b : ℕ) (h : p ∣ x ^ b - y) :
    p ^ k ∣ x ^ r * (x ^ b - y) ^ k * z := by
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left
    (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd h k) _) _

theorem simultaneous_coprime_factors
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (s : Finset ℕ) (d : ℕ → R) (z : R)
    (hcop : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (d i) (d j))
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, d i ∣ z) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, d i) ∣ z := by
  classical
  exact (IsCoprime.prod_dvd_iff hcop).mpr h

theorem triple_capacity
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a b c : ι → ℕ) (B : ℕ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun i => (a i, b i, c i))
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ B) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ B) (i : ι) :
    (univ.filter fun j => a j < a i).card ≤ a i * (B + 1) ^ 2 ∧
      (univ.filter fun j => a j = a i).card ≤ (B + 1) ^ 2 := by
  classical
  constructor
  · have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (f := fun j => (a j, b j, c j))
      (s := univ.filter fun j => a j < a i)
      (t := (range (a i) ×ˢ range (B + 1)) ×ˢ range (B + 1))
      (by
        intro j hj
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hj
        simp [hj, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (hb j), Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (hc j)])
      hinj.injOn
    simpa [Finset.card_product, pow_two, Nat.mul_assoc] using hcard
  · have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (f := fun j => (b j, c j))
      (s := univ.filter fun j => a j = a i)
      (t := range (B + 1) ×ˢ range (B + 1))
      (by
        intro j hj
        simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (hb j), Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (hc j)])
      (by
        intro j hj k hk heq
        apply hinj
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hj hk
        exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext (hj.trans hk.symm) (congrArg Prod.fst heq))
          (congrArg Prod.snd heq))
    simpa [pow_two] using hcard

theorem capacity_packing
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a : ι → ℕ) (Q : ℕ)
    (hless : ∀ i, (univ.filter fun j => a j < a i).card ≤ Q * a i)
    (heq : ∀ i, (univ.filter fun j => a j = a i).card ≤ Q) :
    (Fintype.card ι) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Q * (∑ i, a i) + Q * Fintype.card ι := by
  classical
  have hsplit : ∀ i j : ι,
      (1 : ℕ) = (if a j < a i then 1 else 0) +
        (if a i < a j then 1 else 0) + (if a j = a i then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i j
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hpartition : (Fintype.card ι) ^ 2 =
      2 * (∑ i, (univ.filter fun j => a j < a i).card) +
        ∑ i, (univ.filter fun j => a j = a i).card := by
    simp_rw [Finset.card_filter]
    calc
      (Fintype.card ι) ^ 2 = ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, (1 : ℕ) := by simp [pow_two]
      _ = ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι,
          ((if a j < a i then 1 else 0) +
           (if a i < a j then 1 else 0) + (if a j = a i then 1 else 0)) := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hsplit i j)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [sum_add_distrib]
        rw [show (∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, if a i < a j then 1 else 0) =
          ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, if a j < a i then 1 else 0 from sum_comm]
        omega
  have hl := sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset ι)) (fun i _ => hless i)
  have he := sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset ι)) (fun i _ => heq i)
  simp only [← mul_sum, sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul] at hl he
  nlinarith

theorem triple_packing
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a b c : ι → ℕ) (B : ℕ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun i => (a i, b i, c i))
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ B) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ B) :
    (Fintype.card ι) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * (B + 1) ^ 2 * (∑ i, a i) + (B + 1) ^ 2 * Fintype.card ι := by
  apply capacity_packing
  · intro i
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (triple_capacity a b c B hinj hb hc i).1
  · intro i
    exact (triple_capacity a b c B hinj hb hc i).2

theorem packing_quarter_bound
    (M Q S : ℕ) (hpack : M ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Q * S + Q * M) (hlarge : 2 * Q ≤ M) :
    M ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Q * S := by
  have hMQ : 2 * Q * M ≤ M ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

theorem small_coordinate_sum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b c : ι → ℕ) (B : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ B) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ B) :
    (∑ i, b i + c i) ≤ 2 * B * Fintype.card ι := by
  calc
    (∑ i, b i + c i) ≤ ∑ _i : ι, 2 * B := sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      have := hb i
      have := hc i
      omega
    _ = _ := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

theorem nearest_point_sign
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    (h v : V) :
    ‖h - (2 * inner ℝ h v / ‖v‖ ^ 2) • v‖ ^ 2 = ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · simp [hv]
  · rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hn : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hv)
    field_simp
    ring

theorem strict_distance_drop
    (hh hv hd η : ℝ) (hvpos : 0 < hv) (hdpos : 0 < hd)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hηmax : η < 2 * hd / hv) :
    hh - 2 * η * hd + η ^ 2 * hv < hh := by
  have hbound : η * hv < 2 * hd := (lt_div_iff₀ hvpos).mp hηmax
  nlinarith [mul_pos hη (sub_pos.mpr hbound)]

end UniformDeterminant

statement_fidelity.text:
# Statement fidelity

`Main.lean` uses Lean 4.31.0 and Mathlib. Its declarations are universally
quantified, not finite numerical examples.

The scope is the field-to-order determinant replacement and the uniform
combinatorial estimates, with elementary scalar checks for the geometric
orientation. It is not a formalization of projected-box interpolation or
of the analytic zero-free theorem. In particular a compiling file here must
not be used to mark `C_LS_INTERPOLATION` or the whole `C_LS_CORE` as
kernel-proved.

## Determinants

`replacement_weight_drop` quantifies over all natural-number indices,
weights, primes-as-integers, and nonzero replacement multiplicities. It assumes
`H < p` and `p*m <= a` and proves the precise strict weight decrease.
Primality is unnecessary for this algebraic inequality.

`determinant_row_factors` works over every commutative ring, including rings
with zero divisors, for every square matrix of arbitrary finite size. If each
entry of row `i` is divisible by `p^(k i)`, its determinant is divisible by
`p^(sum k)`.

`determinant_prefix_replacement` assumes an explicit strictly lower-triangular
coefficient matrix `C` and the equality `B = (1+C)*A`. It proves determinant
preservation. Existence of this `C` for the greedy selection follows in the
prose argument, not in this declaration.

`integral_replacement_divisibility` allows a commutative ring `R` to inject
into any commutative ring `K`. The lower-triangular replacement coefficients
are in `K`, whereas the two matrices are in `R`. It assumes the same explicit
replacement equality after applying the injection and rowwise divisibility
in `R`. It concludes determinant equality in `R` and divisibility in `R`.
No integrality of the replacement coefficients, algebraic-integrality
assumption, primality, torsion-freeness, or flatness is hidden.

`frobenius_row_factor` gives the replacement-entry divisibility from the
single congruence `p | x^b-y` over any commutative ring. The Frobenius
congruence for the manuscript's biquadratic order is proved separately in
prose; it is not assumed to be established by this declaration.

`simultaneous_coprime_factors` combines an arbitrary finite pairwise-coprime
family of divisors. For the manuscript this is applied to integer norm
divisors for distinct rational primes, not to an unjustified assertion
that distinct prime elements generate comaximal ideals in every order.

## Uniform counting

`triple_capacity` and `triple_packing` quantify over every finite index
type and every injective triple of natural exponents `(a,b,c)` with
`b,c <= B`. They prove the exact, division-free inequality

`M^2 <= 2*(B+1)^2*S1 + (B+1)^2*M`.

`capacity_packing` proves the more general capacity inequality by counting
all ordered pairs with smaller, equal, or larger first coordinate.
`packing_quarter_bound` deduces `M^2 <= 4*Q*S1` when `M >= 2*Q`.
`small_coordinate_sum` proves `S2 <= 2*B*M`.
The real-power substitutions and manuscript constants are separate scalar
consequences proved in the prose and replayed symbolically by `verify.py`.

## Geometry

`nearest_point_sign` is the reflection/norm identity for an arbitrary real
inner-product space; it does not assert existence of a nearest lattice point.
`strict_distance_drop` verifies the universal scalar inequality used when
`h dot (u-n)>0`. Convex-hull existence, rational-face transversality, and
interpolation on the face are not yet formalized here.
